YOUR CITY.
YOUR SOUND.

Five New York moments. Five different moods. One campaign: Your Life Has a Soundtrack. Explore how Spotify LifeTrack follows the rhythm of the city—from the first sunny commute to the last neon-lit street.

SPOTIFY LIFETRACK
A conceptual music feature
Responding to time, weather, movement, and listener-selected mood. This is an independent student campaign—not an official Spotify release.

One identity / five contexts

THE CITY
NEVER SOUNDS
THE SAME.

The LifeTrack campaign takes ordinary NYC routines and makes them personal. Consistent green audio-wave graphics, strong typography, and cinematic imagery unify the five placements, while the light, weather, time, and music mood change with each scene.

All NYC advertising placements shown are conceptual mockups made for a student design project; they do not indicate actual installed ads or purchased media space.
